findings.summary: Carried from the previous review, still not fixed (dev deferred it on purpose): if a claimant hangs up in the last poll interval after the old session has already read _sessionReplaced (true), clearing the flag afterwards is too late and the old session skips the stop-on-disconnect.
findings.scenario: An editor-launched host with --exit-on-disconnect: a same-user reconnect claims the host and hangs up just as the old session finishes cleanup; the host keeps running with no client (window of at most one 100 ms poll).
